bullets.title: MRVL: Jensen Huang calls it 'next trillion-dollar company'; stock surges 32%+
bullets.body: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang praised Marvell at Computex 2026 as a potential trillion-dollar company and NVIDIA invested $2B in Marvell; MRVL surged ~32.5% intraday and is now up ~57% over two weeks. JPM traders view MRVL as 'unshortable' ahead of S&P announcement, with optical/connectivity names LITE (+13.7%), COHR (+all-time high), FN, and GLW rallying in sympathy. Marvell CEO Matt Murphy framed AI infrastructure as connectivity-constrained rather than compute-constrained, and NVDA's Citi note sees Marvell as the next bottleneck play with $2B NVDA investment backing.

bullets.title: NVDA: Computex Day 2 — $1T+ Rubin/Blackwell orders, Vera CPU, 50%+ FCF return; $5.5T market cap
bullets.body: Citi maintains Buy on NVDA with $300 PT (33.7% upside on 28x C27E). Key takeaways: $1T+ cumulative Blackwell/Rubin orders by 2027, new $200B TAM from Vera CPU targeting agentic workloads, $80B buyback + 25x dividend increase returning 50%+ of FCF. Demand exceeds supply by ~10x per company presentation. Wolfe Research Outperform at $275 PT highlights $0.25-$0.30 EPS tailwind from buybacks by FY28. NVDA market cap back above $5.5T, widest lead over any other company.

bullets.title: PANW: Q3 beat-and-raise; NGS ARR +60% YoY, stock +7.5% AH
bullets.body: Palo Alto Networks reported Q3 revenue of $3.00B vs. consensus $2.94B, EPS $0.85 vs. $0.79, billings $4.18B (+61% YoY vs. $3.40B expected), and NGS ARR of $8.13B (+59.7% YoY). FY26 guidance raised to $11.415-11.425B revenue and $3.77-3.79 EPS. AI data center driving 50% demand surge in network security hardware; Prisma AIRS on track for $100M ARR 'within a couple of quarters.' Stock +7.5% after hours; White House AI EO names PANW and CRWD as best-positioned for FedRAMP cyber budget access.

bullets.title: GOOGL: $80B equity raise for AI capex tanks stock 3.9%; mandatory sale oversubscribed
bullets.body: Alphabet announced an $80B equity raise ($30B secondary offering, $10B private placement to Berkshire Hathaway at ~$350/sh) to fund AI compute infrastructure. Street mixed on supply impact: the raise swings Q4-25 net equity supply from -$44B to +$40B. Stock fell 3.9%. European Parliament plans to switch search from Google to Qwant. Separately, the Anthropic-Google-Broadcom TPU capital stack viewed by some as structurally positive for GOOGL and AVGO long-term.

bullets.title: MSFT Build 2026: Maia 200 (+30% cost/token), Azure AI $37B (+123% YoY), Project Solara, Rayfin
bullets.body: Microsoft Build 2026 keynote showcased Maia 200 custom silicon (30% better cost-per-token vs. standard GPUs), Azure AI revenue of $37B (+123% YoY), and RPO of $627B (+99% YoY). New products include Project Solara (OS for AI agent gadgets), Rayfin (backend-as-a-service for AI agents), Foundry IQ (enterprise knowledge layer), and AION reasoning/planning models. Mayo Clinic partnership for frontier healthcare AI announced. Company doubling cloud capacity within two years with custom silicon ramp.

bullets.title: HPE: First triple play since 2021; stock +19.5% on AI server blowout
bullets.body: Hewlett Packard Enterprise reported its first beat-raise-and-guide triple play since 2021, driven by strong AI and traditional server demand. Stock +19.5% intraday. Evercore analyst Shannon Cross made a negative call at the TMT conference, resulting in a $10 dip mid-session but the stock recovered sharply. Juniper acquisition positioned as strategic linchpin for networking re-rating with high-margin revenue growth.

bullets.title: INTU: Goldman downgrades to Sell with $276 PT on tax competition and MailChimp slowdown
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs downgraded Intuit to Sell (analyst: Gabriela Borges), citing increased competition in tax software and MailChimp growth slowdown. Stock fell 8.9% on the session. Software broadly underperformed with IGV trading 25% above its 50-DMA heading into the downgrade.

bullets.title: GTLB: Beats Q1, cuts 14% of workforce, exits 22 countries; -6.8% AH
bullets.body: GitLab beat Q1 with 23% revenue growth and 3.6% EPS beat vs. consensus, then guided FY to the upper half of its range ($1.112-1.118B revenue, $0.79-0.82 EPS). Simultaneously announced a 14% headcount reduction (~$30-35M pretax charges) and exit from 22 countries. Total RPO $1.1B with cRPO growing 23.8% YoY. GitLab Duo Agent platform cited as promising early traction. Stock fell 6.8% after-hours.

bullets.title: MU/WDC: Morgan Stanley 'Chipflation' report flags AI-driven memory crisis as multi-year margin risk
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley warns AI infrastructure demand is pushing memory prices up six-fold over the past year across HBM, DRAM, and enterprise SSDs, with smartphone/PC supply expected to fall 12-15% short by 2027 despite 30% capacity expansion. Hyperscalers securing long-term agreements crowd out traditional buyers. Memory producers (MU, WDC, STX) benefit from stronger pricing; consumer hardware OEMs face elevated cost exposure and margin risk.

bullets.title: AMD: Q2 CPU revenue +70% YoY, Venice 2nm H2 launch, Helios rack ramp Q4; multi-GW deployments to exceed 2027 forecast
bullets.body: AMD guided Q2 2026 CPU revenue up 70% YoY from unit expansion. Venice 2nm CPU launches H2 2026 with expanding 2027 order book; Helios rack-scale system on track for Q3 2026 with major revenue ramp Q4/Q1. Multi-GW customer deployments expected to exceed initial 2027 forecasts; TSMC partnership ensures prioritized wafer supply through 2027.

bullets.title: SHOP: $3B buyback increase to $5B total; Payments penetration at 67% GMV with 90%+ ceiling
bullets.body: Shopify's board authorized an additional $3B in share repurchases, bringing total authorization to $5B ($1.45B repurchased to date). UBS management meeting takeaways: Payments penetration at ~67% of GMV in Q1 2026 with long-term ceiling of 90%+; Shop Pay surpassed 200M users; GMV at ~14% share of US retail eCommerce. Share repurchase authorization represents a positive capital return signal.

bullets.title: CRM: AgentForce +200% YoY, H2 2026 revenue reacceleration expected on AI monetization
bullets.body: Salesforce at BofA conference: AgentForce grew 200% YoY and 50% sequentially in Q1 2026; customers beginning the agenting journey increase spend 50-100% while advanced users show 3-4x average order value. H2 2026 revenue reacceleration expected as AI monetization and headless/360 strategy expand TAM. Non-seat pricing (consumption and enterprise) now being offered.

bullets.title: META: Morgan Stanley raises PT to $775 on AI search, subscriptions, ad upside, neocloud optionality
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley sees four products that could re-establish META as an AI winner: AI search ($10B+ revenue potential), subscriptions ($7B revenue / ~$2 EPS), core ad revenue upside (every 1% = ~$3.5B), and neocloud leasing (1GW at ~$10B/GW = ~$3 EPS). PT raised to $775, implying ~30% upside; model assumes 21%/18% ad revenue growth in '27/'28.

bullets.title: ANET: Reiterates $11.5B FY26 guidance at 28% growth; $3.6B deferred revenue driven by AI deployments
bullets.body: Arista Networks at William Blair reiterated FY26 revenue guidance of $11.5B (+28%) with 46% operating margin. Deferred revenue of ~$3.6B is primarily AI-related with 12-18 month milestone recognition. A third customer expected to exceed 10% of revenue; potential fourth under review. Campus lead times reduced to six weeks.

bullets.title: ROKU: $675M EBITDA guidance, DSP fully integrated; political ad spend to match 2024 election levels
bullets.body: Roku at Evercore TMT: $675M 2026 EBITDA guidance with FCF expected to exceed $700M; $2.4-2.5B cash and no debt. New personalized home screen at 20% penetration with biddable ad units planned. Full DSP integration including Amazon and Google DV360 (H2 2026). Political ad spend in 2026 expected to match 2024 general election levels peaking Oct-Nov.

bullets.title: STX: 4-5 quarters of sequential growth with H1 2027 visibility; 50TB drive qualification by end-2027
bullets.body: Seagate at BofA conference projects 4-5 quarters of sequential revenue and profit growth based on existing orders, with precise exabyte, mix, and pricing commitments through H1 2027. Factory utilization maxed out; growth to come from higher-capacity drives. 50TB drive qualification targeted before end-2027. Shareholder returns prioritized with increased dividends and buybacks as debt reduces.

bullets.title: CMCSA: Peacock reaches profitability in Q2 2026; Apple and Walmart bundle partnerships key growth driver
bullets.body: Comcast at Evercore TMT: Peacock achieved profitability in Q2 2026 ahead of prior guidance. Next growth phase emphasizes bundling partnerships including recent deals with Apple and Walmart. Discipline maintained on subscriber growth with focus on high ARPPU and positive customer lifetime value. Some softness in international theme park demand.

bullets.title: BE: CEO rules out equity raise to meet data center demand; stock +10.7%
bullets.body: Bloom Energy CEO told Bloomberg no equity raise is needed to meet data center demand, allaying dilution concerns. Stock rose 10.7%. Separately, Mizuho raised ENPH PT to $54 (from $37) and GEV PT to $913 (from $904) on the acceleration of 800VDC power architecture for data centers scaling to 1MW+ densities.

bullets.title: NFLX: 7th straight red day, longest losing streak since 2022; down 23% from April peak
bullets.body: Netflix is on track for its seventh consecutive down day, its longest losing streak since 2022. The stock bounced 42% from mid-February to mid-April but has since fallen 23%, remaining 37% below its all-time high. No new fundamental catalyst identified; the stock appears caught in a sector rotation out of communications services (-2.6% on the day).

bullets.title: TTD: -9.1% on CFO appointment; Raymond James media day June 4
bullets.body: The Trade Desk fell 9.1% following a CFO appointment announcement. Raymond James hosting a media day June 4 with TTD management meeting at 9:00-9:30 AM. No change to fundamental business update noted; move appears to reflect market concern over leadership transition.
